# Self-hosted open fonts

These fonts are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Keep the adjacent license files with the fonts when redistributing the website. No proprietary ABC Favorit or BP26 font files are included.

## Archivo

- Copyright 2020 The Archivo Project Authors; [upstream](https://github.com/Omnibus-Type/Archivo).
- File: `archivo-latin-variable.woff2` (Google Fonts Latin subset, normal style).
- Variable axes verified in the font binary: weight 100–900 and width 62–125 percent (Google Fonts CSS advertises the requested 75–125 percent width range). Use 100 percent for body text and 125 percent for wide display text.
- License: `Archivo-OFL.txt`.
- Binary source: https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/archivo/v25/k3kQo8UDI-1M0wlSfdnoLmvDIaI.woff2
- License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/archivo/OFL.txt

## IBM Plex Mono

- Copyright © 2017 IBM Corp.; Reserved Font Name “Plex”; [upstream](https://github.com/IBM/plex).
- Files: `ibm-plex-mono-latin-400.woff2` and `ibm-plex-mono-latin-600.woff2` (Google Fonts Latin subsets, normal style).
- Weights: Regular 400 and SemiBold 600.
- License: `IBM-Plex-Mono-OFL.txt`.
- Binary sources:
  - https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F63fjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n1i8q131nj-o.woff2
  - https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/ibmplexmono/v20/-F6qfjptAgt5VM-kVkqdyU8n3vAOwlBFgsAXHNk.woff2
- License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/ibmplexmono/OFL.txt

The unmodified font files were retrieved on 2026-10-15 from the official Google Fonts CSS API and Google Fonts repository. Latin subsets cover the site's English text and common punctuation; unsupported symbols use the browser fallback font.
